svg.title: Aeronautical engineering: my thesis laminate and fibre-angle sweep, the longitudinal stability of a light aircraft, and three views of my conceptual aircraft; plus my Engineers Australia assessment as an Aeronautical Engineer, ANZSCO 233911.
svg.text: Supervised engineering work, each drawing built from the real numbers in the work.

svg.aria-label: Plan view of the thesis wing with a fixed root, pressure load and fibre angle theta; the three-ply lay-up, 0.125 mm per ply; and the 19 fibre angles from minus 45 to plus 45 degrees

Static margin bar with centre of gravity at 27.3 percent and neutral point at 46.2 percent of mean aerodynamic chord; s-plane plot of the short-period poles, natural frequency 5.344 radians per second and damping ratio 0.702, and the phugoid poles, 0.2127 radians per second and damping ratio 0.106
svg.text: Static margin, on the mean aerodynamic chord

svg.aria-label: Three orthographic views of my conceptual fighter-style aircraft: 8.0 metre span, 12.0 metre length, 18.0 square metre reference area, aspect ratio 3.56, taper ratio 0.286, with the wing-root offset I found and fixed marked in the front view
svg.text: Root offset +0.30 m found and fixed
Residual 1 to 5 mm in all views
One datum and centreline for every view

text.tspan: CATIA V5 surface model, AutoCAD views

svg.text: Professional Engineer: Aeronautical Engineer, ANZSCO 233911. Assessed 29 October 2026.

text.tspan: My competencies, together with my BEng in Aircraft Design and Engineering from Nanchang Hangkong University,
meet the requirement for the occupation.
